name: classifier
instructions: Identify the customer's primary intent in this banking support message.

criteria.activate_my_card: Activate or enable a new card
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Digital wallet (Apple Pay, Google Pay) setup or use. Example: 'Can you please assist me in Apple Pay, in getting Top Up to work?'
criteria.atm_support: ATM usage, fees, limits. Example: 'Is there a fee when I get cash from an ATM?'
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Balance unchanged after transfer. Example: 'Can you please check my UK Account? I made the transfer a couple of hours ago.'
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Balance unchanged after cash/cheque. Example: 'My app is showing a cash balance that I did not receive.'
criteria.cancel_transfer: Stop/cancel transfer. Example: 'I want to take back my transaction'
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card expiring soon. Example: 'Tell me how to replace my expired card.'
criteria.card_arrival: When is new card coming. Example: 'How will I get my card?'
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: Tracking card delivery. Example: 'Can I get my card fast tracked?'
criteria.card_not_working: Card declined/failing. Example: 'I have enough money in my account, so why is my card being declined?'
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: Card payment not in account. Example: 'I didn't make a payment that shows in my app.'
criteria.card_swallowed: Card retained by ATM. Example: 'Can you help me retrieve my card?'
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: Cash withdrawn but missing. Example: 'My app is showing a cash balance that I did not receive.'
criteria.change_pin: Change PIN code. Example: 'I can't find the PIN.'
criteria.compromised_card: Card used fraudulently. Example: 'I think that there is a payment on my card that I did not authorize.'
criteria.country_support: International support or restrictions. Example: 'In which countries can I get a card?'
criteria.declined_card_payment: Card payment rejected. Example: 'I have enough money in my account, so why is my card being declined?'
criteria.declined_transfer: Transfer rejected. Example: 'I'm getting an error when trying to make a payment. I want to purchase a flat but my mortgage payment needs to go through.'
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits on virtual cards. Example: 'What's the limit on total number of cards I can have?'
criteria.exchange_rate: Currency exchange rates. Example: 'Are EUR exchanges allowed?'
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: Unexpected charge. Example: 'How can I dispute a debit transaction?'
criteria.failed_transfer: Transfer failed. Example: 'Hi, I'm in progress of purchasing a flat and am trying to make to make a payment. An error is appearing.'
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which currencies supported. Example: 'Are EUR exchanges allowed?'
criteria.get_physical_card: Request physical card. Example: 'I can't find the PIN.'
criteria.getting_spare_card: Duplicate/extra card. Example: 'What's the limit on total number of cards I can have?'
criteria.getting_virtual_card: Request virtual card. Example: 'I heard you have virtual cards. How do I get one?'
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card lost/stolen. Example: 'Can you help me retrieve my card?'
criteria.order_physical_card: Order new card. Example: 'I'm wanting to get a Visa card today.'
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot password. Example: 'I can't find the PIN.'
criteria.pending_card_payment: Card payment in progress. Example: 'I bought something and already paid for it but now I don't see it.'
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving funds/transfer. Example: 'Can my friend send me money?'
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards/currencies accepted. Example: 'Why doesn't it work when I use American Express to try to add money to my account?'
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fee for card top-up. Example: 'What do you charge to top up US cards?'
criteria.top_up_failed: Top-up didn't complete. Example: 'Google Pay won't let me top up.'
criteria.topping_up_by_card: Adding funds via card. Example: 'Why doesn't it work when I use American Express to try to add money to my account?'
criteria.transfer_into_account: Receiving transfer. Example: 'Would I be able to use SWIFT transfers?'
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Transfer not received. Example: 'Why is my transaction taking so long to complete?'
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take. Example: 'What's the normal time frame for a transfer from a UK account?'
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Card brand support. Example: 'Please help me get a Visa card.'
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why verification needed. Example: 'Can I use my account without verifying identity?'
